profile: Fresh isolated desktop profile; same profile and package for two complete exit/restart cycles

native_observations.details: Binance BTCUSDT spot 1h rendered about 1500 bars; WebSocket label and changing OHLCV observed.
Created 7s on the independent right spot chart; rendered 1503 bars while left chart retained 1h.
Changed right chart to Binance USD-M BTC/USDT:USDT swap.linear. Requested 7s was preserved, chart displayed an explicit rejection with native alternatives, and left 1h chart continued updating.
Complete exit/restart preserved both identities, layout, independent grouping and right 7s rejection; no silent 1h substitution.
Selected 1m from the rejection panel. Right contract chart rendered 1502 bars and showed realtime WebSocket status.
Entered 90s and pressed Return. Selector displayed a precise composition rejection, retaining current 1m chart. Saved 7s remained present and disabled.
Entered 120s, normalized to 2m, selected Add and switch. Right contract chart rendered 1502 bars with realtime WebSocket status; left chart retained 1h.
Second complete exit/restart preserved left spot 1h and independent right contract 2m, rendered both charts, and restored realtime status with subsequent OHLCV changes.
